name: Young Royals
description: Prince Wilhelm adjusts to life at his prestigious new boarding school, Hillerska, but following his heart proves more challenging than anticipated.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Following a scandal, Prince Wilhelm enrolls in a new boarding school, Hillerska. His second cousin, August, plans an initiation party in his honor.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Simon and Wilhelm spend time together outside of school. Desperate for ADHD medication, August attempts to get diagnosed. Rowing tryouts commence.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Hillerska hosts a spirited Parents' Weekend but a bevy of surprises, disappointments and more occur for Wilhelm, August, Felice and Simon.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Wilhelm struggles with his grief and what the loss of his family member means for his future. Simon pressures August to repay him.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: August and Wilhelm face off over how to resolve a disciplinary problem at school. Sara revels in hanging out with Felice and her friends.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Wilhelm feels conflicted about how to handle the aftermath of the leaked video while Simon fends off the press. Felice makes a discovery.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Animosity lingers between Wilhelm and August as a new semester at Hillerska begins. Sara finally gets to experience campus life.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Negotiating the harsh consequences of his rebellion, Wilhelm presents the Queen with an ultimatum. Birthday celebrations remind Sara she's an outsider.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: A combative rowing competition gets even more heated due to Simon's surprise guest. Summoned by the Queen for a talk, August fears for his future.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Rumors about a girl in Wilhelm's room circulate while Sara's fling might be short-lived. The girls rebel against antiquated Valentine's Ball traditions.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Last-minute changes to the choir's jubilee performance disappoint Simon. A therapy session leads to big revelations for Wilhelm.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Secrets come to light as an unexpected renegade spoils Simon's plan. Wilhelm's fateful speech approaches — will he rise to the occasion?

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Wilhelm's speech has consequences not only in the court but also throughout the school. The prince and Simon are determined to enjoy their relationship.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: School restrictions and court politics put a strain on Wilhelm and Simon. August's attempt to make amends goes unacknowledged. The gang goes camping.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Wilhelm sees the throne looming on the horizon. Sara contemplates returning to Hillerska. The online harassment of Simon follows him home.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: August and Vincent organize a strike action that exposes the differences between Wilhelm and Simon. Felice and Sara can no longer avoid each other.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Wilhelm confronts his past and future at his lavish birthday ceremony. August finds hope in the arms of Sara. In the palace, Simon makes a decision.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: With Hillerska's fate hanging in the balance, Wilhelm and Simon weigh duty against love as they discover what it takes to truly follow their hearts.
